blind_prompt:
You are a meticulous AI researcher conducting an important investigation into activation vectors from a language model. The model read the following text, and we are looking at its internal activation at the token marked with [[ ]].

<text>{context_left_64}[[{token_str}]]{context_right_16}</text>

Describe the semantic content that this activation most likely encodes. Produce an explanation enclosed within <explanation> tags, consisting of 2-3 text snippets describing that vector, in the same style a trained activation verbalizer would use.
left_only: same prompt with context_right_16 removed, first 100 evaluation positions
rawctx: context_left_64 + token_str fed verbatim to AR as the explanation
